paragraphs: Meremar—or, if you wish, Rav Yeimar—told Mar Zutra, 'I attended the exposition of Rav Pinḥas son of Rav Ammi' (see his entry). 'If so, it is difficult; rather, it is clear as Rav Huna,' etc., Pesaḥim 100a. Meremar applied to him, 'Yeimar permits a firstborn' (see his entry). Ravina spoke to him, Shabbat 100a, 129a; Yoma 81b. Ravina objected to Meremar, Shabbat 81b. Ravina said: Amemar told me: Meremar said in Rav Dimi's name, Gittin 19b. He told Ravina, 'Thus your father said in Rav (Yosef)'s name,' Nedarim 60b; there 90a, 'Thus your father said in Rav Pappi's name.' This requires examination: Ravina's father spoke in Rav Yosef's name, Rava's teacher, and in Rav Pappi's name, Rava's student.
